submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured (merit budget 3), the Mn-rich film (Ca0.19Co0.18Mn0.63) gave the highest photocurrent at 5e-8 A. The Co-rich corner was lower, and the Ca-rich region gave a negative photocurrent. All three values are very small, so the ranking is only tentative.
